title: elapsed

arguments.description: nonzero resets and arms the timer when creating the object

body: The [elapsed] object detects the frequency/period between bangs. By default, the first bang into the left input resets and arms the timer. If you give it a nonzero argument, the object is reset and armed at creation. The right inlet takes a bang that resets the timer. This is way too dimilar to Vanilla's [timer], but with a different (and more intuitive/regular hot left inlet) design.
